_note: Generated race tracks (Phase 5: track/). A track is its seed + its parameters + the generator's version: the same three always make the same track (track/generate.js). presets: what the track generator page and the Track scene offer. How each style builds its layout and the limits every track keeps to (the tightest corner, run-off, gradients, banking…) belong to a generator version and never change with it: track/gen/v1.js STYLES and LIMITS. build: the road and ground made from a track (track/build.js; not part of a track's identity). surfaces: the road, its verges and the ground round it (as Map v3's: the tyres and the effects).

params._note: type: circuit (a closed loop) or p2p (a sprint or hillclimb). lengthKm: [min, max]. corners: [min, max] corner groups (a chicane or esses count as one). style: flowing, technical, fast or mixed. width: m. elevation: m from the lowest point to the highest. climb (p2p): m from start to finish (negative: downhill). banking: the most banking in fast corners, degrees (0: none). crests: sharper rises and dips allowed. bridges: the track may cross itself on a bridge (not yet built: always false).

build._note: The road and the ground (track/build.js). step: m between cross-sections of the road mesh. verge: m of flat run-off either side, the same height as the road's edge, left for kerbs and barriers (Phase 5 Step 2). margin: m of ground round the track. cell: the ground grid's spacing (m, at least; bigger tracks: bigger cells, at most maxCells across). blend: m over which the ground meets the land round it.
